At will: Counterspell, Shield

special_abilities.name: Regional Effects
special_abilities.desc:
Venger's presence fouls the regions his lairs inhabit, creating the following effects:
Desolate Terrain: Plant life within 1 mile of a lair withers and dies, creating a barren wasteland of cracked dirt.
Tormented Rest: Abyssal whispers plague visitors' dreams. Whenever a creature other than Venger or his allies finishes a Long Rest within 1 mile of a lair, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 Exhaustion level.
If Venger dies or moves a lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Venger makes three attacks, using Crimson Claw or Crimson Blast in any combination.

actions.name: Crimson Claw
actions.desc: m +11, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Crimson Blast
actions.desc: r +11, range 120 ft. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Venger casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):
At will: Detect Magic, Invisibility, Mage Hand, Silent Image
2/day each: Alter Self, Contact Other Plane, Create Undead, Dimension Door
1/day each: Control Weather, Imprisonment

legendary_actions.name: Booming Censure
legendary_actions.desc: wis DC 19, one creature Venger can see within 60 feet.  14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.  Half damage only.

legendary_actions.name: Crimson Strike
legendary_actions.desc: Venger makes one Crimson Claw or Crimson Blast attack.

legendary_actions.name: Magic-Binding Chains
legendary_actions.desc: dex DC 19, one creature Venger can see within 30 feet.  The target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn. While Restrained, the target can't take the Magic action.  Venger can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

name: Vestige Companion
hit_points_roll: 4 + four times your Warlock level (the vestige has a number of Hit Dice [d6s] equal to your Warlock level)

special_abilities.name: Pact Bond
special_abilities.desc: Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw the vestige makes.

actions.desc: m,r Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 1d6 + 3 plus your Charisma modifier Fire (Fiend), Necrotic (Undead), or Radiant (Celestial) damage.
